decision_conditions: <p>The application has been submitted under Section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) to vary Condition 1 (Approved Plans) of planning permission ref: 2023/0240. However, a comparative review of the physical works undertaken demonstrates that the development has been constructed in material non-compliance with the approved drawings. In accordance with established case law (<i data-path-to-node="6,0" data-index-in-node="467">R (Atwill) v New Forest National Park Authority [2023]</i>), the parent permission was never lawfully implemented and has subsequently lapsed. As Section 73 cannot be utilised to vary a permission that is no longer extant, the Local Planning Authority has no legal jurisdiction to entertain or grant an application under this procedure.</p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-b9156cd6-7fff-bce1-714a-2a343df8db6d"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">By reason of the increase in scale of the dormer roof enlargement, the development fails to appear subordinate to the host building and instead dominates the rear roof slope to the detriment of the character and appearance of the existing building, the integrity of the wider row of terraced properties, and the positive contribution these properties make to the significance of the Clapton Square Conservation Area. The identified harm would not be outweighed by any public benefits of the development. The development, therefore, conflicts with policies D1, D3, D4 and HC1 of the London Plan (2021), policies LP1 and LP3 of the Hackney Local Plan (2020), the NPPF (2024) and the guidance as contained within the Council’s </span><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:italic;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Residential extensions and alterations SPD.</span></p>
description: Variation of condition 1 (approved plans) attached to planning permission ref: 2023/0240 (granted on 29/03/2023) for "Construction of a rear roof extension".
